profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer | Technical Lead | React • TypeScript • Vue
profile.summary: Technical Leader and Senior Software Engineer with 20+ years of experience building scalable enterprise web applications and cloud platforms. Hands-on expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue and modern frontend architecture, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and user experience. Proven leader who collaborates across cross-functional teams, mentors engineers, and delivers high-quality software that drives business success.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and develop scalable cloud-based web applications for TP-Link's networking and consumer platforms using React, TypeScript, Vue, and modern frontend technologies. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, high-performance user experiences, optimize application performance, build reusable components, and contribute to frontend architecture, code quality, and Agile software development.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer | Technical Team Lead
positions.description: Led and mentored a team of software engineers while remaining hands-on in the design, development, and delivery of high-traffic enterprise applications using React, TypeScript, Vue, JavaScript, Angular, and C#. Collaborated with Product, QA, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, high-quality solutions, drive technical excellence, and successfully execute Agile development initiatives.

positions.title: Lead UI Developer (HSTechnologies)
positions.description: Led frontend development for the Sam's Tech Portfolio Planning Platform using React and Redux, delivering scalable enterprise web applications and improving application performance by over 50%. Developed reusable UI components, implemented unit testing with Jest and Enzyme, and collaborated with cross-functional teams in Agile Scrum to deliver high-quality software.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Software Development · React.js · TypeScript · JavaScript · HTML · CSS · Leadership · Testing

positions.title: Sr. UI Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed the next-generation Resolve Web UI from the ground up using React and Redux, delivering enterprise features for security automation, dashboards, and system management. Integrated the platform with ServiceNow, enhanced application security with OWASP CSRFGuard, and collaborated with global cross-functional teams in an Agile environment to deliver high-quality software.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Software Development · React.js · JavaScript · HTML · CSS

positions.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed, developed, and tested Western Digital's next-generation Personal Cloud web platform and user interfaces for the My Book Live, My Cloud, and My Passport Wireless product families. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver responsive, high-quality web applications using JavaScript, PHP, RESTful APIs, and modern web technologies.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Software Development · JavaScript · PHP · jQuery · HTML · CSS · Windows · Linux · Cloud Computing · Shell Scripting · Embedded Software · Storage

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description: Designed, developed, and tested web-based management interfaces, embedded applications, and enterprise storage solutions for Quantum DXi systems and tape automation platforms. Integrated secure web technologies, performed systems verification across SCSI and Fibre Channel environments, and collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable enterprise-class storage products.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Embedded Software · JavaScript · jQuery · HTML · CSS · SCSI · PHP · Fibre Channel · SNMP · Windows · Linux · C++ · XML · Shell Scripting · TCP/IP · Testing · Storage
